mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (particularly hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia) which may lower seizure threshold and reduce lacosamide efficacy while increasing CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and seizure control closely; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly and consider lacosamide dose adjustment if renal impairment develops.
